newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: INSIGHT - DUTCH CHARTISTS LOOKING FOR NEW AEX HIGH.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - DUTCH CHARTISTS LOOKING FOR NEW AEX HIGH.

text.p: Dutch chartists supported the
idea on Monday that the AEX share index was at the threshold of
a new phase of record breaking.
Five out of six chartists said the index would rise this
week, while only one opted for the downtrend. "The short term
cycle remains bearish," Fibonacci said, adding last week's
consolidation was likely to continue this week.
The AEX index ended at 587.20 points on Friday, October 11,
2.27 points above the previous Friday, but the gain would have
been greater if a dipping Wall Street had not put a halt to the
advance.
In the week before that the index had gained 13.01 points.
ABN AMRO was firmly holding to the belief that the AEX would
continue its rally this week and set new highs, while Iris added
little doubt, saying that the uptrend was still intact as long
as an intermeditate low of 579 holds up as support.
The AEX share index was up 0.83 points at 588.03 by
mid-afternoon on Monday.

Note - Contributors' own analysis follows.
ABN AMRO - The AEX is continuing its rally to set new highs.
This is the scenario we have in mind for the coming week. The
most important support level to watch is the 579 level. Prices
below that price level would limit upward potential for the
short run. However, that is not the direction we are focusing
on. Our target still lies at 603, and after that, even higher.
Negative divergence and Overbought readings are absent in the
current market situation, so there are no restrictions for
higher prices.
ING Barings - The AEX is slowly breaking out of its 3-week
rising trend channel, expressing weakening short term
technicals. Last week's fall below 587 has damaged the market's
condition a bit. First support comes in at the upper side of a
minor 'gap area' which has been formed two weeks ago at
578-579.50. Money flow indicators have started to show neutral
readings, indicating the 3-week uptrend of the AEX is running
out of fuel. Upside potential seems limited towards 591. We
expect the AEX to consolidate recent gains at current levels. A
trading range may have commenced between 579 and 591, but this
should only be a pause in the strong underlying bull trend.
The medium term uptrend, which started in August lows at
512, is intact and offers now strong support at 576.
IRIS - The uptrend is still intact and seems to have formed
a new intermediate low at 579. As long as this low holds up as
support we expect a further rise in the index.
Fibonacci Press - Last week's consolidation is likely to
continue this and probably next week. The short term cycle
remains bearish suggesting moderate weakness. Resistance at 590,
and support at 579 and around 576. As long as 571 is not broken,
higher prices are likely thereafter.
